topic: Neonatal jaundice: assessment, phototherapy and exchange transfusion

mcqs.question: What does CG98 say about bilirubin assays when using the threshold tables?

options.A: All laboratory assays are interchangeable without local advice
options.B: There is variability between manufacturers, so consult the local pathology laboratory when interpreting thresholds
options.C: Only transcutaneous bilirubin may be used after 24 hours
options.E: Thresholds apply only to conjugated bilirubin

mcqs.correctAnswerText: There is variability between manufacturers, so consult the local pathology laboratory when interpreting thresholds
mcqs.explanation: CG98 notes assay variability and tells professionals to consult their local laboratory when interpreting the threshold tables.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Note that there is variability between assays from different manufacturers in reported bilirubin measurement.

mcqs.question: In the CG98 consensus table for babies 38 weeks or more, which actions match a bilirubin above 200 and above 300 micromol/L at 24 hours?

options.A: Above 200 start phototherapy; above 300 perform exchange transfusion unless the level falls while treatment is prepared
options.B: Above 200 observe only; above 300 start phototherapy
options.D: Neither threshold changes management before 72 hours
options.E: Above 200 give phenobarbitone; above 300 give agar

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Above 200 start phototherapy; above 300 perform exchange transfusion unless the level falls while treatment is prepared
mcqs.explanation: The consensus table row at 24 hours is >200 and >300 micromol/L, and the action line that follows the table is start phototherapy, then perform an exchange transfusion unless the bilirubin falls below threshold while treatment is prepared.

mcqs.question: At 96 hours or more, for babies 38 weeks or more, which CG98 thresholds apply?

options.A: Phototherapy above 350 micromol/L and exchange above 450 micromol/L
options.E: Phototherapy only if the baby is under 35 weeks

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Phototherapy above 350 micromol/L and exchange above 450 micromol/L
mcqs.explanation: The row for 96 hours or more is >350 and >450 micromol/L. The action line orders the columns as start phototherapy, then exchange transfusion.

sourceRefs.excerpt: 96+ >350 >450 Action Start phototherapy Perform an exchange transfusion

mcqs.question: Which action does CG98 say not to take during an exchange transfusion?
mcqs.explanation: CG98 says do not stop continuous intensified phototherapy during exchange, and do not do a single-volume exchange, routine albumin priming, or routine intravenous calcium.

sourceRefs.excerpt: During exchange transfusion do not: stop continuous intensified phototherapy perform a single‑volume exchange use albumin priming routinely administer intravenous calcium.

mcqs.question: Which list does CG98 say not to use to treat hyperbilirubinaemia?

options.A: Agar, albumin, barbiturates, and charcoal, among other agents
options.C: Exchange transfusion at the exchange threshold

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Agar, albumin, barbiturates, and charcoal, among other agents
mcqs.explanation: CG98 lists agar, albumin, barbiturates, charcoal and several other agents as treatments not to use for hyperbilirubinaemia.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Do not use any of the following to treat hyperbilirubinaemia: agar albumin barbiturates charcoal
